title: Hospital reprimands Italo for filming the room with James Fox
place_text: Maternity ward, regional hospital, Varginha, Brazil

tellings.quote: No, they just prohibited me from filming inside. And that's right, because once I filmed, I went into the maternity ward with James in the room where it was.

plain: In 2023, a hospital in Varginha, Brazil, banned the surgeon Italo Venturelli from filming inside after he took the documentary filmmaker James Fox into the maternity ward room where, Venturelli says, the being his hospital is said to have treated was kept. Venturelli tells Michels this as something that happened to him, and says the ban was fair: 'they just prohibited me from filming inside. And that's right.'
